title: collapse_by_thread fetches full Email objects just to read threadId
description: email.rs collapse_by_thread calls get_objects::<Email> for all query-result IDs to read their threadId fields. For large result sets with large Email objects (body structures, body values), this pulls unnecessary data. Expected impact: O(N * email_size) vs O(N) if the backend could return just threadId. Fix: add a MailBackend::get_email_thread_ids(&[Id]) -> Vec<(Id, Id)> method, or at minimum document the overhead so backends can short-circuit.
